decision: The changed H2 artifact/rootfs interaction and fresh ordinary F1 resident-install capability pass this rereview, including deterministic reconstruction, fresh -03 absent-only deployability, exact first-boot proof repair, rollback, and no closed -02 reuse. Live D1 remains FAIL_STOP because normal execution dispatches cleanup before proving returned status 1,1, and the eight-record result-publication repair path contacts the device before performing its otherwise host-only close repair.

init.file_type: ELF 64-bit LSB executable, ARM aarch64, statically linked, stripped

native_artifact_interaction.judgment: The native H2 machinery is unchanged; the execution-critical interaction change is the exact compiled rootfs path/hash and resulting boot/init artifact. Independent reconstruction reproduced the new artifact exactly and the source tests prove the manifest binds the fresh -03 path and hash.

live_f1_review.deployability: Fresh ordinary absent-only resident-install is structurally available. The fresh run has its exact keyed rootfs and fresh D0/path-preflight evidence; final, work, and stage paths were recorded absent. Its rootfs path exactly matches the rebuilt H2 compiled binding. No staging-live, f1-live, terminal journal, or approval from closed run -02 is reused.
live_f1_review.first_boot_and_repair: PASS. Pre-transfer state uses the exact profile enable/latch paths and a script-bound successful framed receipt. First resident boot requires exact command, rc, trust, BEGIN/END command, sequence, argc, status, unique 0,0 status, unique unarmed log, and no dispatch log. Terminal repair reconstructs and revalidates the exact shell script and status/log command receipts. Non-H2 legacy journals remain accepted only without H2 proof fields.
live_f1_review.rollback_and_recovery: PASS. The existing exact V2321 boot-only rollback, one candidate transfer maximum, no candidate replay, rollback-only post-attempt failure, candidate health, final resident health, and journal repair boundaries remain intact.
live_f1_review.live_conditions_not_waived: Fresh immediately pre-effect D0, exact USB target pin, path absence, recovery availability, attendance, guard arm, manifest binding, and all ordinary live gates remain mandatory. This capability qualification grants no device authority.

d1_closed_properties: The v2 journal is an exact nine-record state machine: open, arm intent, arm result, reboot intent, observation, cleanup intent, cleanup result, final health, and closed.

Reserved common keys cannot be replaced by payloads. Every present prefix is checked for exact filename continuity, action, key set, canonical timestamp, closure and artifact bindings, arm-intent hash, dispatch counts, no replay, cleanup disposition, final result hash, and closed equality.

Empty reconciliation returns NO_DURABLE_EFFECT_EVIDENCE without a device read. Forged or cross-bound journals return JOURNAL_INCONSISTENT_STOP. Only all nine exact records return CLOSED_EXACT_NO_REPLAY.
Arm intent precedes exactly one arm, exact post-arm state is 1,0, fresh resident D0 precedes one durable reboot intent, and uncertain arm or reboot is never resent.

A six-record uncertain cleanup intent is never resent. Exact resident D0 source/work absence and health may infer cleanup closure; work presence parks. Final health and one complete unique benchmark segment are result-bound.
Read-only reconcile contains no arm, reboot, handoff, cleanup, payload, partition, or flash dispatch.

findings.finding: Normal execute writes cleanup-intent and dispatches the cleanup shell before finalize_cycle performs the exact returned H2 status check for enable=1 latch=1.
findings.evidence: Independent source-order inspection found cleanup-intent, then base.run_f1_shell cleanup, then result = finalize_cycle; require_auto_status(enable=1,latch=1) is inside finalize_cycle.
findings.safety_effect: Cleanup is a D1 device effect and must not be dispatched until the exact returned native state is established. The current order can attempt cleanup while return/health is still unproven and does not satisfy returned-status -> cleanup -> final-health closure.
findings.required_fix: Obtain and validate exact 1,1 before durable cleanup intent and dispatch, bind that return proof to the cleanup boundary, then perform cleanup and a distinct fresh final resident health check. Preserve one cleanup maximum and no replay.

findings.finding: resume_after_return with eight valid records, where final-health is durable and only the closed publication is missing, constructs effect arguments and calls require_auto_status before writing the ninth closed record.
findings.evidence: An independent host-only mocked eight-record invocation raised a sentinel from require_auto_status, proving that a device status read is attempted before result publication repair.
findings.safety_effect: Result-publication repair is required to be a host-only journal repair. Device contact is unnecessary, can fail after final health is already durable, and prevents deterministic publication repair despite no remaining device work.
findings.required_fix: Add a len(records)==8 early path that validates the durable final-health result/hash entirely from the journal, writes only the exact closed record, revalidates nine records, and returns without _effect_args, status, D0, cleanup, arm, reboot, or any device contact.

validation.independent_native_rebuild: PASS; exact boot/init/ramdisk/helper match to provided -06 A/B receipt
validation.d1_static_cleanup_order: FAIL; cleanup dispatch precedes exact returned 1,1 proof

review_trigger: Fresh rereview is required after either D1 finding changes the runner hash or journal semantics. The changed native/rootfs and Live F1 PASS_GO axes remain reusable only while their named artifacts, selectors, receipt validation, rollback/recovery machinery, and hazard assumptions remain unchanged and no new hazard or incident occurs.
final_judgment: PASS_GO for the changed H2 native/rootfs interaction and exact Live F1 resident-install capability. FAIL_STOP for Live D1 and therefore FAIL_STOP for combined live execution until D1-ORDER-003 and D1-PUBLISH-004 are fixed and independently rereviewed. No device authority is granted; S22+ was untouched.
